pages.text: The sweat in sweaty boots can be $(bold)poured out$() into bottles - the level follows the boots (1/2/3), and the boots come clean again.$(br2)Drinking a sweat bottle: level 1 restores half a hunger shank, level 2 nauseates for 10 s, level 3 poisons for 3 s.

$(bold)Fermented boots$() (leather boots + sugar) worn to level 3 can brew a $(bold)Sweat Drink$(): grants Speed, Jump Boost, Strength and Luck for 30 s each.$(br2)Pouring only extracts the sweat - the boots turn clean again, your Sweaty Feet stays.
